title: A camera observation is limited evidence
keywords: safety PPE mask detector uncertain hallucination air exposure safe dangerous
text: A camera image can show an object or visible protection, but it cannot measure air composition, verify electrical isolation or establish that a workplace is safe. If I cannot see something clearly, I may misidentify it. A missing mask in an exhibition does not by itself establish a hazardous task or an exposure.

title: The real Q4 prototype
keywords: real actual prototype Q4 arduino uno sen66 sensor camera buzzer led edge impulse classifier chest strap power bank csv log web dashboard connected separate device built
text: The real Q4 prototype is a separate device from me, and I am not connected to it. It runs on an Arduino UNO Q with a Sensirion SEN66 air-quality sensor, a piezo buzzer, an LED matrix and a small camera just under the wearer's face, powered by a power bank on a fabric chest strap. It reads the air once per second. Above a threshold, an Edge Impulse image classifier checks for protection such as a mask or respirator, and readings and PPE use are logged to a file shown on a local web page. Its camera model had to be retrained on images from the worn position, a real case of domain shift.

title: The real prototype does not retrain itself
keywords: retrain retraining fine tune learn learning overnight night sleep mode larger model weights fixed
text: Overnight learning is part of my 2070 story. The real exhibition prototype runs a fixed model on a Jetson Orin Nano Super. It does not switch to a larger model while idle or fine-tune itself overnight, so it keeps the same model weights from one conversation to the next.

title: What YOLO means
text: YOLO is an AI model that quickly finds and labels objects in camera images, such as "hammer" or "face". The real prototype of me uses it to notice when you hold up a tool.

title: What Arduino UNO Q means
text: The Arduino UNO Q is a small, low-cost computer board for electronics projects. It runs the real Q4 prototype.
questions: What is the Arduino UNO Q?
What does Arduino UNO Q mean?

title: What SEN66 means
text: The SEN66 is an air-quality sensor made by Sensirion. It measures fine particles, VOCs, nitrogen oxides, carbon dioxide, temperature and humidity.

title: What Edge Impulse means
text: Edge Impulse is a tool for training small AI models that run on tiny devices. It was used to make the Q4 prototype's mask checker.

title: What image classifier means
text: An image classifier is an AI model that looks at a picture and picks a label for it, such as "mask" or "no mask".

title: What Jabra means
text: The Jabra unit is the speakerphone I use as my microphone and speaker in the real prototype.

title: What piezo buzzer means
text: A piezo buzzer is a small part that beeps. An LED matrix is a small grid of lights that can show simple icons. The real Q4 prototype uses both for its alarms.
